name: git-file-write-options-reconciled
body:
Reconciliation record for `worktree-write-scope` feedback-15, feedback-16 and feedback-17 (spec-writer, correction round 2). Findings treated as UNTRUSTED, then confirmed.

SOURCE STATEMENTS.
- feedback-15 (→ `requirements.constraint.main-integration-via-merge-gate-only`): the navigator's "read-only" `git diff *` and `git log *` grants accept `--output=<file>`, which writes an arbitrary file (including inside the main checkout), breaking `global.constraint.worktree-isolation`.
- feedback-16 (→ `requirements.constraint.agent-changes-always-on-main`): the same for the agent-builder's `git log *`.
- feedback-17 (→ `requirements.note.worktree-write-scope-decisions`): items (2) and (3) still say "edit allow globs" and "keep read-only status/diff/log/branch", both replaced by the wave-1/wave-2 reconciliation.

CONFIRMED against the templates + code graph.
- `solution.component.codebase-navigator-prompt` —implemented-by→ `opencode-suite/agents/codebase-navigator.md`; its frontmatter `bash:` block lines 71-76 grants `git diff *` (line 72) and `git log *` (line 73) as read-only.
- `solution.component.agent-builder-prompt` —implemented-by→ `opencode-suite/agents/agent-builder.md`; its frontmatter `bash:` block line 37 grants `git log *` as read-only.
- git's diff/log output-redirect option `--output=<file>` writes to the named file; a `git diff *`/`git log *` glob therefore admits a write to any path, including the main checkout, which `global.constraint.worktree-isolation` forbids. The finding is CORRECT.
- feedback-17: the note's item (2) says `agentFsGlobs` reads "edit allow globs" and item (3) says "keep read-only status/diff/log/branch"; both were superseded by `requirements.note.fs-scope-deny-mirror` (feedback-14) and `requirements.note.navigator-branch-grant-reconciled` (feedback-13). CORRECT.

RESOLUTION [autonomous]. NARROWING IS NOT POSSIBLE: the opencode bash grant surface is a prefix/glob form with no negation, so no pattern can express "`git log *` except `--output=<file>`". The reviewer's second option is taken — DECLARE THE FORM FORBIDDEN AND RECORD IT AS A KNOWN RISK, exactly as `git rebase *`'s worktree-only rule already is. The exact checkable phrase, stated in the constraint, the requirement's acceptance criteria, and both components, is: "`--output=<file>` is FORBIDDEN on every granted git verb"; the residue (the glob cannot exclude the form) is recorded as a prose-enforced known risk, and `git diff`/`git log` output goes to stdout only.
- Amended `requirements.constraint.main-integration-via-merge-gate-only`: added the residual-risk paragraph — `--output=<file>` forbidden on every granted git verb, alongside the existing `git rebase *` cwd risk.
- Amended `requirements.requirement.navigator-no-unguarded-main-git`: the KEEP diff/log bullet carries the caveat, and a new AC pins the forbidden form.
- Amended `solution.component.codebase-navigator-prompt`: the template must state the forbidden form.
- Amended `requirements.constraint.agent-changes-always-on-main`, `requirements.requirement.agent-builder-main-flow`, `solution.component.agent-builder-prompt`: same forbidden-form declaration for the agent-builder's `git log *`.
- Amended `requirements.note.worktree-write-scope-decisions`: items (2)/(3) carry "SUPERSEDED (in part)" pointers to `requirements.note.fs-scope-deny-mirror` and `requirements.note.navigator-branch-grant-reconciled` (history preserved, not deleted).

CONSISTENCY. `global.constraint.worktree-isolation` (main read-only to every agent except the two carve-outs; main written only by `apg project merge` + the agent-builder/release-agent carve-outs) is now consistent with the navigator/agent-builder git-grant prose: the only read-only-looking git verbs that can write a file are explicitly forbidden, with the `git rebase *` cwd rule as the precedent.

SPINE UNCHANGED. All six amendments are edge-preserving `apg node update`s — no node or edge was added or removed by them: `requirements.user.navigator-agent` ⊃ requirement —drives→ domain —realised-by→ component —implemented-by→ code, and `requirements.note.worktree-write-scope-decisions` → `details` → the constraint/requirement it already served, are intact.

CODE FOLLOW-UP (separate plan task; the spec is the contract, the plan owns the edits). The templates must (a) keep the narrowed read-only grant sets, and (b) state the forbidden form:
- `opencode-suite/agents/codebase-navigator.md`: in the git-grant prose add that `--output=<file>` is forbidden on every granted git verb and `git diff`/`git log` go to stdout only.
- `opencode-suite/agents/agent-builder.md`: same for `git log *`.
The exact checkable outcome: neither template instructs or permits passing `--output=<file>` (or any output-redirecting option) to `git diff`/`git log`; both state the forbidden form.

[autonomous]
